name: The Winter Relic
objective: Team Krampus is searching for something beneath Frostpine: an ancient object known as the Winterheart. Reach the shrine first.
intro: Legends say the Winterheart was used centuries ago to control a powerful Pokémon. Team Krampus is already at the shrine when you arrive.
dialogue: Krampus Archaeologist: "This shrine predates every village in the region. It belongs to us."
Krampus Archaeologist (defeated): "Too late. The relic is already gone."
lore_discovery: Team Krampus has already stolen part of the relic.
